verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs describe natural-language operation directly: users can 'describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent' and 'talk to agents like teammates... @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work' with replies/statuses/follow-ups, plus goal-based agent creation ('define the goal, set the rules, watch the results'). This covers both configuring and operating the product via NL commands. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that NL commands reliably execute intended actions (community evidence only covers general UX complaints, not NL command reliability).
